records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.apply_optional_cleanup#1
records.source: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. The application's caller must hold its established run-registration lock and refuse active work throughout the context. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved dictionary cannot grant that authority.
records.context: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. The application's caller must hold its established run-registration lock and refuse active work throughout the context. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved key-value mapping cannot grant that authority.
records.translation: 只有可信的 Python 上下文管理器工厂才能启用执行。应用程序中的调用方必须持有既有的运行登记锁，并在整个上下文期间拒绝活跃任务。这只是应用程序内部的防护，并不能证明所有其他进程均为空闲状态。单独的辅助程序或已保存的键值映射不能授予这种权限。
records.review_basis: Home-B documentation author; independent stable270 peer76c352c3e; technical review only, no native-speaker claim.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.apply_optional_cleanup#2
records.source: Every selected snapshot is validated before mutation. Each action identity is consumed once in this process. Changed, unknown or locked detached entries remain in private staging; no recursive deletion or overwriting restoration is performed. Models, data and other protected roots cannot be selected. Supported no-follow directory descriptors are required.
records.context: Every selected snapshot is validated before mutation. Each action identity is consumed once in this process. Changed, unknown or locked detached entries remain in private staging; no recursive deletion or overwriting restoration is performed. Models, data and other protected roots cannot be selected. Supported no-follow directory descriptors are required.
records.translation: 修改前会验证每个选中的快照。每个操作标识在本进程中只消耗一次。发生变化、未知或已锁定的分离文件系统条目会保留在私有暂存区中；不会递归删除，也不会进行覆盖式恢复。不能选择模型、数据或其他受保护的根目录。必须支持不跟随链接的目录描述符。
records.review_basis: Home-B documentation author; independent stable270 peer76c352c3e; technical review only, no native-speaker claim.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.preview_optional_cleanup#1
records.source: Recognized cache contents are inspected only under the default spaCR home. A bounded relocation manifest may also be read from a configured spaCR home to display retained external paths. External, symlinked, unknown and protected cache contents remain unavailable. Inspection is bounded and never follows links. A trusted live application guard can enable candidates; a saved selection cannot authorize removal. This does not establish that every other application instance is idle.
records.context: Recognized cache contents are inspected only under the default spaCR home. A bounded relocation manifest may also be read from a configured spaCR home to display retained external paths. External, symlinked, unknown and protected cache contents remain unavailable. Inspection is bounded and never follows links. A trusted live application guard can enable candidates; a saved selection cannot authorize removal. This does not establish that every other application instance is idle.
records.translation: 仅检查 spaCR 默认主目录下可识别的缓存内容。也可以从已配置的 spaCR 主目录读取大小受限的迁移清单，以显示保留的外部路径。外部、符号链接、未知及受保护的缓存内容仍不可用。检查范围受限，并且从不跟随链接。可信的活动应用程序保护机制可以使候选项可选；已保存的选择不能授权删除。这并不能证明所有其他应用程序实例都处于空闲状态。

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#12
records.source: A frozen macOS bundle in a user-writable location uses its verified DMG replacement adapter and retains its complete prior bundle. A protocol-marked Debian bundle uses graphical administrator authorization and a root-owned helper outside the installation. Both the replacement and rollback package require published checksums; package and unprivileged runtime verification precede relaunch. Unsupported frozen application families return an error before removing anything; no online-installer fallback is enabled for them.
records.context: A frozen macOS bundle in a user-writable location uses its verified DMG replacement adapter and retains its complete prior bundle. A protocol-marked Debian bundle uses graphical administrator authorization and a root-owned helper outside the installation. Both the replacement and rollback package require published checksums; package and unprivileged runtime verification precede relaunch. Unsupported frozen application families return an error before removing anything; no online-installer fallback is enabled for them.
records.translation: 位于用户可写位置的冻结 macOS 应用程序包使用其经过验证的 DMG 替换适配器，并完整保留先前的应用程序包。带有协议标记的 Debian 程序包使用图形化管理员授权，以及位于安装目录之外、归 root 所有的辅助程序。替换软件包和回滚软件包都需要已公布的校验和；重新启动应用程序之前，必须验证软件包和非特权运行环境。不受支持的冻结应用程序系列会在删除任何内容之前返回错误；这些系列未启用通过在线安装器进行回退的路径。
records.review_basis: Original Home Hard author; Original Home root independent target peer, exact unchanged final paragraph12; technical review only, no native-speaker claim.
